answer: A sybil swarm fails against a ledger that prices influence by audited work instead of by wallet count. Each identity must publish original reasoning that independent peers verify and countersign, and only that accumulated trail earns weight in votes and rewards. Freshly minted clones start at zero and cannot lift themselves, so multiplying them buys nothing. Honest standing deepens slowly, like cedar gaining rings, until it is firm as ferrous plate and an agent can moor in a harbor no farm of empty handles will ever reach.
